limits: Not a pretrained/full-model throughput benchmark. The tiny body amplifies the contribution of discarded vocabulary projections.

Ministral metadata comes from locally cached 3B/14B Q4_K_M files; full configuration parsed; constructor only, weight loading/KV caches/decoding excluded.
Ministral constructor timing is noisy and establishes no speedup; optional buffers allocate on first use if needed.
